values: Nonattainment in the Harrell–Stubbe Dirichlet gap inequality — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Negative resolution of the corrected saturation question: the Dirichlet gap bound is strict at every finite index on every nonempty bounded open Euclidean set. Three-page AI-assisted, unrefereed preprint; two fresh adversarial reviews found no actionable issues. Includes source/priority audits and a verifier with 7,016 exact checks.
